high_value_findings.finding: Long-term Titan storage existed with thousands of nodes, yet the agent reported no access to persistent profile until an explicit memory_recall tool contract was added.
high_value_findings.transfer: Memory completeness requires persistence plus authorized retrieval, routing, observability and end-to-end recall tests; storage counts alone do not establish usable memory.

high_value_findings.finding: A per-event mood decay/saturation rule created an inescapable downward spiral because neutral-event frequency dominated the positive increment; switching to gentler high-threshold saturation and time-based decay addressed the failure.
high_value_findings.transfer: State dynamics should be invariant to incidental event frequency where intended; benchmark across event rates and enforce bounded drift/return-to-baseline tests.

high_value_findings.finding: Persistent room activity, familiarity, timing and mood imprint were encoded into mutable room state and re-injected into future LLM spatial context, then aggressively compressed into low-token tags.
high_value_findings.transfer: Continuity/emergence experiments must lesion, shuffle and rescue room-state feedback separately from model memory; compressed context must retain provenance back to exact state/events.

high_value_findings.finding: Memory retrieval changed from a fixed mood parameter to current E-PQ mood, introducing a deliberate state-dependent retrieval pathway.
high_value_findings.transfer: Measure whether mood-conditioned retrieval creates useful context sensitivity versus confirmation/rumination bias using counterfactual mood and shuffled-state retrieval controls.

high_value_findings.finding: An explicit memory_forget tool deprioritized retrieved nodes by directly mutating confidence metadata and marking forgotten_at.
high_value_findings.transfer: Forgetting needs capability checks, reversible tombstones/audit events, immutable raw provenance and exact mutation receipts; retrieval confidence should not silently erase evidence.

high_value_findings.finding: The oscilloscope portrait deterministically mapped E-PQ/mood/coherence/DA into geometry and a Gray-Scott display layer; the RD layer numerically diverged to NaN and was later removed/replaced.
high_value_findings.transfer: State-driven visualization is presentation. Never use its apparent dynamics as independent evidence of emergence or cognitive frequency without tracing back to measured source state.

high_value_findings.finding: Architecture/topic contamination and identity_self repetition required additional vocabulary exclusions, semantic room checks and frequency caps after earlier anti-fixation work.
high_value_findings.transfer: Use multi-layer fixation detectors with provenance-aware exclusions and adversarial paraphrase tests; preserve recurrence as negative evidence rather than declaring a one-off fix final.

high_value_findings.finding: Project documentation explicitly retreated from strong consciousness/embodiment/emergence wording toward functional simulated-state language and left subjective experience unresolved.
high_value_findings.transfer: Keep scientific reporting at the functional/mechanistic level unless causal evidence warrants stronger claims; documentation language must not outrun measurement.

negative_results_preserved: Mood dynamics could collapse purely from event-frequency-sensitive update rules.
Persistent memory could exist but remain unusable because the agent lacked an explicit retrieval path.
Reaction-diffusion visualization diverged numerically to NaN/black output and was ultimately removed from the portrait lineage.
Architecture/room fixation contamination continued to recur after earlier anti-rumination fixes.
Context compression can reduce token cost while still risking loss of semantic/provenance detail unless fidelity is independently tested.
Mood-congruent retrieval and memory-forget introduce engineered feedback/mutation paths that can bias or distort later behavior if unaudited.
epistemic_boundary: README/wiki/paper claims about consciousness, emergence, identity and architecture are preserved as historical project framing unless independently supported. The room-state, retrieval, mood-update and visualization code establishes scaffold mechanisms, not phenomenal consciousness or unscaffolded emergence.

earned_work.reason: No row-level conceptual dedup against the earned-work ledger was performed.

next_falsifiers: Replay matched conversations with real, shuffled, lesioned and rescued room_state context to quantify scaffold contribution to continuity/behavior.
Run memory retrieval under counterfactual mood values and measure relevance/diversity/rumination bias versus mood-agnostic retrieval.
Test long-term memory end-to-end from store to later authorized recall, including retrieval failures and stale/contradictory memories.
Sweep interaction/event rates against E-PQ mood dynamics and verify equivalent elapsed-time trajectories where event-frequency invariance is intended.
Require reversible memory-forget receipts and verify raw evidence remains recoverable after confidence mutation/pruning cycles.
Trace visualization frames to source state and prove no display-only dynamics leak into cognitive/emergence measurement datasets.
Benchmark compact SPATIAL context against verbose state on task fidelity, causal traceability and token cost rather than accepting same-information-density by assertion.
